# SMSApp documentation

> Public documentation for SMSApp: send reviewed SMS jobs from your own Android phone's SIM, prepared in a web dashboard. Plans: Free, Pro and Family (https://smsapp.aoneahsan.com/pricing).

The Android app `com.aoneahsan.smsapp` version 1.7.0 is live on Google Play as "SMS Mobile App": https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aoneahsan.smsapp. The web dashboard prepares and monitors jobs. Version 1.7.0 predates the move to Supabase; the next release runs on it.

## Product contract

- Anyone signs in with Google; each account registers its own Android phone. One selected phone per job.
- Enrollment is explicit and off by default.
- The phone sends through one configured default SMS subscription.
- Recipient sources are that phone's completed contact sync or a UTF-8 CSV up to 5 MiB.
- A job contains at most 5,000 unique eligible recipients; the plan can set a lower limit (Free: 100 per job, 100 messages a month).
- Only ordinary Pakistani mobile numbers in `030`–`036` are eligible.
- Foreign, landline, short, service/premium, malformed, and unrecognized destinations are excluded without override.
- Supabase (Postgres with row-level security) stores authenticated state; it is not an SMS gateway.
- The app never reads received SMS and is not a default SMS handler.
- Android sent callbacks do not guarantee carrier delivery. Uncertain outcomes are never retried automatically.
- Carrier charges, consent obligations, and platform limits still apply.
